rules: R1

source immutable; user text and explicit answers provenance; AI suggestions not verified facts. Required missing/conflict/rights unknown/invalid values block ready. Optional unknown omitted if profile permits. User final approval confirms presented values, not hidden assumptions.
R2
profile ref pinned from preparation through execution/result; pre-start revision or reauth invalidates prior review; newer incompatible profile requires re-prepare or error stop if accepted.
R3

source/target/profile selection and answers editable only pre-accept, no edits during active auth input; abandoning pre-start auth fences old viewer. Different platform => independent registration with same source.
R4

one explicit start after user reviews all actual registration fields, assets, account/target, goal, procedure summary and no rollback notice. Approval and accept atomic against revision+digest; no separate plan management.
R5

same start key+same canonical payload returns existing registration even after expiry/terminal; different payload conflict. Server-generated registration ID and semantic effect identity stable. New key cannot bypass target/operation guard. Owner isolated; existing target proof returned only to authorized owner. Genuine distinct new lesson intent requires distinct valid slot, not random key to retry uncertain effect.
R6

on every external potentially mutating meaningful operation, validate active job, pinned scope, current permission/identity/lease, target and allowed operation, effect ledger; persist admission before dispatch. read and mutation both scoped. No unproved pending/unknown retry. Effect classification uncertain => treat as potentially mutating. Record minimum evidence not passwords/OTP/cookies/screens containing secrets.
R7

normal proof => done; genuine system error including permission/auth loss or incomplete required evidence => stopping then stopped. User can query only; no user cancel, resume, rebind, rollback or edit after start. Viewer disconnect not error by itself. Finalize with known/unknown without waiting indefinitely; late trusted observations only add result evidence.
R8
profile-specific goal proof only; if sufficient response no redundant read; current mock profiles require independent readback. Receipt not publication. Environment enforced server-side mock only.
R9

prepare and start are separate user actions; page may display preparation preview before auth but no separate mandatory approval. Final review includes actual values/asset references not only a digest. Current source and preparation issues visible.
atomicity and isolation are required contract properties, not claims of runtime proof; concrete DB/queue/browser/transport chosen by implementation. No live external access/actual account data.

ports.output: auth viewer grant or verified account/target observation or reason

goal spec, trusted observed effects and evidence

shared_boundaries: CO passes same immutable Profile (or ref + resolved content) to PREP/EXEC/RESULT, no mandatory each-role registry service. EXEC is sole browser access; persistence and browser runtime are infrastructure interfaces with contract constraints, not added business roles. Result evaluator may be pure function in runner; no separate service required. CO owns lifecycle and acceptance.

wire.conventions: Authenticated owner from service context; all timestamps UTC; IDs opaque; revision nonnegative integer; JSON except source multipart; closed request shapes, reject unknown keys/invalid enum; response no secrets. Error {code,message,issues?,current_revision?}. HTTP 400 invalid syntax, 401 login, 404 not owned/not found, 409 stale/conflict/phase/duplicate, 422 unresolved input, 503 runtime/model unavailable. User errors before accept do not create job; after accept execution errors stored as result.

SourceInput.note: multipart metadata JSON + named uploaded bytes; explicit rights for each referenced asset; source ID denotes immutable snapshot; preserve raw user assertions, no LLM confirmation

RegistrationInput.note: known platform/allowed URL only; create independent prestart registration; unsupported does not start a job

PreparationEdit.note: at least one change; answers keyed by issue/field; server revalidates; no direct patch of stored approval or arbitrary steps; accepted forbidden; auth input active requires close first

AuthCommand.note: action open|finish|close|refresh; generation required for finish/close/refresh; open only ready prestart, finish revokes human input and verifies stable account/target, close abandons only prestart, refresh issues short-lived viewer grant only in current auth phase; no secret in request

StartInput.note: approved must true, digest of server generated review, stable key reused for retransmission; same key replay checked before mutable current conditions

SourceView.note: asset metadata/digest/rights and owner-authorized preview ref; preview transport delegated

RegistrationView.note: job_state null before accept, otherwise active/stopping/done/stopped; preparation {values,issues,provenance,ready}; auth {state,generation?,account_label?,viewer_grant?}; viewer grant only when explicitly issued by auth command; review includes digest, actual values/assets, verified account/target, profile, ordered procedure summary, goal, environment; no browser secrets; result includes goal verdict, steps/effect, error/evidence, next action, environment

RegistrationList.note: owner-scoped summaries {registration_id, source_id, profile_ref?, job_state, result_summary?}

wire.status_notes: H1/H4 create 201; H7 accept 202 with registration_id; same key replay 200 or 202 with current persisted view of same registration. H5/H6 200; no-op rejected. H8 never triggers external reads. POST auth finish may take bounded time or return verifying, subsequent GET observes result; no separate mandatory workflow state for auth. Review digest canonical JSON of exact scope; format/hash canonicalizer agreed during integration (not client-computed).
